[[Tuzes-Adaz]], the [[chief]]tain of [[Rokrul]], a [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] village on [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]], had a '''son'''. When her son came of age, every adult [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] in the village, besides [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], [[Orvos]], had been taken captive by the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and transformed into [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]]. Seeing no better time to be a man, Tuzes-Adaz and her son quickly ventured into the forest to perform the manhood initiation ceremony, which was to steal a tail scale of the large and dangerous [[Horax/Legends|horax]]. After finding one, the young boy began the extraction process. However, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], while searching for [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]], killed the horax single-handedly, inadvertently interrupting the young Nelvaanian's initiation process.
